name: Black Hills Energy (gas)
notes: Researched from public blackhillsenergy.com pages only. Log in to pay by checking/savings (no fee), card or digital wallet (PayPal, Google Pay, Apple Pay, Venmo). Guest pay for unregistered customers: card/wallet through a third-party system (Paymentus) or checking/savings through the guest pay options page. Convenience fees are published only for cash at walk-in locations (amount not stated, fees.notes); the payment page states no card fee (reviewer removed the card-fee note; card fee stays the family default). Automatic Bank Transfer: bank only, deducted on the bill due date (next business day if weekend/holiday); starts once the bill shows Automatic Bank Transfer; stop requests must arrive at least 5 business days before the due date (not enforceable; shown as a note). Paperless: paper stops within 30 days of enrollment. Payment arrangements can be set up online (My Account financial assistance). Start/stop/move service online under Customer Service. Phone 888-890-5554 (automated pay line and customer service, Mon-Fri 7-5 MT per search snippet; hours not on a fetched page so omitted). Sign-in identifier and MFA not documented. This is the gas record of a combination gas/electric utility; no electric dossier exists for Black Hills.

help.title: Payment options
paragraphs: Log in to pay with a checking or savings account, a debit or credit card, or a digital wallet (PayPal, Google Pay, Apple Pay or Venmo). Without an online account, use Guest pay: cards and digital wallets go through a third-party payment system, and checking or savings payments use the guest pay options page. UnitedHealthcare Ucard is not accepted.

Call 888-890-5554 to pay through the automated phone system. Mail a check payable to Black Hills Energy with your account number in the memo to P.O. Box 7966, Carol Stream, IL 60197. Cash payment locations charge convenience fees; drop boxes in Colorado and South Dakota take checks only.

help.title: Automatic Bank Transfer
paragraphs: Automatic Bank Transfer deducts your bill amount from your bank account on the due date; if the due date falls on a weekend or holiday, it happens the next business day. It begins once your bill shows Automatic Bank Transfer, so keep paying until then.

Enroll or stop online, by calling 888-890-5554, or by writing to PO Box 6006, Rapid City, SD 57709-6006. Stop requests must arrive at least 5 business days before your bill's due date. When an account closes, the final bill is still withdrawn on its due date.

help.title: Paperless billing
paragraphs: Sign up on the billing settings page in My Account and accept the terms. Paper bills stop within 30 days, and each month you get an email with your due date, amount due and a link to pay. You can also get a text when your bill is ready and a due-date reminder, and cancel at any time.

help.title: Payment arrangements
paragraphs: Eligible customers can set up a payment arrangement online to bring a past-due balance current: the balance is split evenly over an agreed period while the regular monthly bill is still due. Budget Billing, which averages monthly payments, may be a better fit than a long arrangement.

help.title: Start, stop or move service
paragraphs: Submit a request online under Customer Service, then Start, stop, move service, whether you are moving within our service area or leaving it.
